context: A boss and his manager read political headlines together
purpose: Teach: 安倍/福田/中川/藤田/一郎/仁/隆/剛

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おい、見たか。安倍元首相の特集が今日の新書版に載ってるぞ。
lines.en: Hey, did you see? Today's pocket edition has a feature on former PM Abe.
lines.style: Gruff boss tone, casual command, slightly nostalgic edge

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、福田さんの名前も出てきますね。まさしく平成の懐かしい顔ぶれです。
lines.en: Yes, Fukuda-san's name comes up too. Really, what a nostalgic Heisei lineup.
lines.style: Polite office-worker register, agreeable, mildly impressed tone

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 中川さんの写真もあるな。若いころのほうが、ずいぶん精悍に見える。
lines.en: There's a photo of Nakagawa-san too. He looks far sharper in his younger days.
lines.style: Reading aloud, mildly amused, deeper voice with chuckle

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: コメントを寄せているのが藤田さんですよ。相変わらず厳密な分析ですね。
lines.en: The one giving the commentary is Fujita-san. As rigorous in analysis as ever.
lines.style: Informative polite delivery, slightly impressed, calm professional voice

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ふむ、山田一郎の発言も載ってるじゃないか。農林の現場を知る男だ。
lines.en: Hmm, Yamada Ichiro's remarks are in here too. A man who knows the agriculture field.
lines.style: Surprised grunt, pointing at the page, authoritative tone

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 西郷隆盛の名前まで引いて、道徳について語っていますよ。
lines.en: He even invokes Saigo Takamori's name and talks about morality.
lines.style: Thoughtful summarizing tone, measured polite delivery, mild surprise

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 剛健な保守派らしい論調だな。最近はこういう声、めっきり減ったよ。
lines.en: Sounds like a robust conservative's argument. You hardly hear voices like this anymore.
lines.style: Serious boss reflection, weighty pause, mildly wistful delivery

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 締めくくりは仁愛の精神を説く一文で、なかなか味のある記事でした。
lines.en: It wraps up with a line about the spirit of benevolence — quite a flavorful piece.
lines.style: Closing summary, slightly admiring, calm professional finish
